# Implement the planned pages

Read the selected direction, storyboard, edited copy, and media inventory. At representative: build the homepage and representative interior. At pages: implement remaining routes and repair reviewer findings. Adapt local components to compositions; don't choose the narrative from a starter stack.

Use blocks as optional copy sources. If renaming a component, update its class selectors and variants consistently. Build distinctive treatments where blocks don't fit. Keep ordinary controls accessible, semantic markup, keyboard navigation, image dimensions/alt, and functioning actions.

For the representative homepage and interior, follow `components.md` to inspect viable block previews and record the selection trace. Check the resulting full-page rhythm after compilation; a good isolated block can still be wrong next to its neighbors. If the package has no current image evidence, say so in the trace and inspect the live local render before accepting the choice.

Place media with attention to intrinsic content and crop. Keep text-bearing graphics legible. Retain supported business meaning when adjusting copy to fit. A themed restyle may change component CSS and composition while preserving facts and integrations.

Do not edit raw harvest, business facts, or approved copy to disguise a visual failure. For an upstream factual defect, record the required correction instead. Run build and inspect actual output. The next browser and critic nodes provide independent acceptance.
# Contact behavior

If a page offers a lead form, mark the form `data-lead-form` so the compiler binds its action to the kernel lead endpoint. Give every field a native label and meaningful validation. The browser review submits synthetic values against a mocked local response and must see the success state. A form that simply reloads the same page is an essential-functionality defect. A direct phone or email route is also valid when it matches the business's actual contact process.
